The process of installing gateways on Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus V7.1.0, 7.2.0, and 7.2.1 consists of downloading the appropriate installation package, and installing each of the patches that the package contains.

This technote describes how to perform the following tasks if you are running either Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus V7.1.0, 7.2.0, or 7.2.1:

OMNIbus TCP/IP Ports; OMNIbus Ports; OMNIbus Port Usage; OMNIbus Default Ports; OMNIbus Communication Ports; IDUC port TECHNOTE (FAQ)

QUESTION
 What TCP/IP communication ports are used by Netcool/OMNIbus? 

CAUSE
Need to know the Netcool/OMNIbus TCP/IP port usage for firewall considerations. 

ANSWER
 

Netcool/OMNIbus ObjectServer uses port 4100 as default to communicate with other components. Gateway, probes, other clients, and process control agents also need ports to be assigned or configured. Ports are specified using the Server Editor (nco_xigen) or omni.dat file (and using nco_igen) to generate the interface file used by OMNIbus components. The interfaces file contains a list of IBM Tivoli Netcool/OMNIbus components and the ports assigned.

For example, the default ports (that can be modified) used by Netcool/OMNIbus components are ObjectServer (4100), Process Control Agent (4200), Gateway (4300 ), Proxy Server (4400), IBM Eclipse Help System - IEHS (8888), and an available port for IDUC communication.

ABSTRACT
A new version of the Netcool/OMNIbus Gateway for Siebel eCommunications will be available to download from October 1, 2010.

CONTENT
 

The gateway has been updated to remove its dependance on Sybase.

The following APARs have also been addressed:

 * IZ38822 - Problems related to selecting non-default separation characters resolved.
 * IZ40952 - The gateway was providing incorrect feedback if SRNumber was not retrieved.
 * IZ54526 - The gateway was not shutting down gracefully when its reader lost its connection to a primary ObjectServer in a failover pair configuration.
 * IZ64145 - The gateway was not generating failover messages on failover to a primary ObjectServer.
 * IZ70550 - The Siebel Gateway documentation was updated to provide more details about the communciaton betweeen the various components within the integration.

You can download this package from the IBM Passport Advantage website:

If you are encountering problems locating packages in Passport Advantage, remove any characters generated by the copy-paste operation before searching, or manually enter the part numbers into the search field.
